lines.text: 可比爱情更要紧的是感情。我心里满满都是情意，可是能给谁呢？谁要呢？
lines.en: Where am I? I don't seem to be anywhere. If death is like this, I don't think much of it. Everything's gone. People, trees, birds, wine. Well, up yours!
lines.note: IMDb quotes 逐字核证（tt0071129）；格拉迪斯卡理发店独白。

lines.text: 这是哪儿？我好像哪儿也不在。死亡要是这个样子，我可看不上它。
lines.en: Where am I? I don't seem to be anywhere. If death is like this, I don't think much of it.
lines.note: IMDb quotes 逐字核证（tt0071129）；大雾场景祖父语。
